defaults_inventory.description: Path to the default inventory file (static or dynamic).

defaults_gathering.description: Fact gathering mode: 'smart' (only if needed), 'explicit' (manual only), or 'implicit' (always).

defaults_timeout.description: Default SSH connection timeout in seconds.

defaults_remote_user.description: Default remote username for connecting to hosts. Leave empty to use the current local user.

defaults_pipelining.description: Enable SSH command pipelining to reduce connection overhead. Requires passwordless sudo if used with privilege escalation.

defaults_fact_caching_connection.description: Connection string or path for fact caching (e.g., file path for jsonfile, Redis URL).

defaults_log_path.description: Path to a file where ansible run logs (playbook events) are written. Requires write permissions.

defaults_callback_whitelist.description: List of callback plugins to enable (e.g., 'timer', 'profile_tasks', 'yaml').

privilege_escalation_become_user.description: Default user to become after privilege escalation.

privilege_escalation_become_ask_pass.description: Prompt for privilege escalation password if needed.

ssh_connection_control_path.description: Directory and filename template for SSH control sockets used in connection reuse.

ssh_connection_retries.description: Number of retries if SSH connection fails (0 = infinite or until success).

inventory_enable_plugins.description: List of inventory plugins to enable and use for parsing inventory sources.

inventory_host_key_checking.description: If true, SSH will check and verify host keys (recommended for security).

inventory_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for dynamic inventory scripts before they are killed.

galaxy_server_list.description: List of Galaxy servers for role and collection downloads.

items.description: URL of an Ansible Galaxy-compatible server.
